The guard trusts aws_connect_partner_by_code (SQL 32) by the sha256 of its three row writes and by its owner, so the engine also requires connect exactly as SQL 32 defines it (body sha256 1d8e36de…, SECURITY DEFINER, search_path=public, row_security=off: partnership_connect_pinned), owned by a role that is not checksops and that checksops is not a member of (partnership_connect_not_api_owned), and no other trigger on the table (tenant_partnerships_no_other_trigger). Prerequisites: tenant_partnerships with inviter_tenant_id, invitee_tenant_id, status and revoked_at; SQL 90's aws_user_tenant_ids() and aws_can_write_tenant(uuid); aws_connect_partner_by_code(text, uuid); auth.uid(); role checksops. No table, column, grant, other policy or row change; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin. Adds one trigger (the DB validator already requires it).
